svg.aria-label: Agent Hub drawn as a circuit board. Phone, tablet and laptop connect through Tailscale to the Hub on your PC. The Hub feeds the autonomous LLM pipeline - OpenCode, fed by the skill library; Missions; Dispatch, which works both ways with the orchestrator that runs the agent team; a git worktree that draws the Git Graph; Review and Apply, which loops back - and the media tools. TALK, the voice surface, is wired into both the pipeline and PC control through Windows MCP.
svg.text: Every device reaches one address. Nothing is exposed to the internet.
one app on your PC · binds 127.0.0.1
speak; it becomes an ask or an action
An ask becomes a mission, runs in a private copy of your repo, and comes back for your approval.
re-plan and carry on, until you apply or discard
A successful run is kept as a routine and replayed next time.
Fetch it, convert it, and reach your drives from the phone in your hand.
